app.title: MyADB
app.subtitle: Wireless ADB controller
webview.warning: This WebView is too old (detected {version}). Some styles may break. Please update Android System WebView.
status.title: Status
status.desc: State comes from a real listener check, not from property values.
control.title: Control
control.desc: Changing the port restarts adbd. Existing wireless connections will drop.
boot.title: Start on boot
boot.desc: Apply the saved port automatically once boot completes.
boot.label: Enable on boot
connect.title: Connect
connect.desc: Run one of these commands on your computer:
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.desc: Check adbd, port occupancy and system restrictions.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDesc: Applies immediately and is written to the module config.
settings.toggleAdb: Enable system USB debugging when turning on
settings.toggleAdbDesc: When off, only the ADB port is set; the global USB debugging switch is left alone.
settings.restoreAdb: Restore USB debugging state when turning off
settings.restoreAdbDesc: Restore adb_enabled from the snapshot taken before enabling.
settings.keysDesc: Manage /data/misc/adb/adb_keys. Clearing creates an automatic backup first.
settings.keysClearDesc: The current keys are backed up automatically, then the file is emptied.
error.10: The system manages ADB listen addresses; this tool will not take over
error.12: adbd failed to start; previous port restored
error.status: Cannot read status. Check that the module is installed correctly.
about.description: myadb is a KernelSU / Magisk / APatch module that controls the TCP port of the system adbd, with custom ports and start-on-boot.
usb.title: USB and device
usb.desc: Manage USB debugging, developer options and USB mode.
usb.adbDesc: Toggle system adb_enabled. Turning it off may drop the current ADB connection.
usb.changeWarning: Changing the USB mode may briefly drop USB/ADB; reconnect afterwards.
usb.unsupported: This system does not support USB mode control.
keys.devicesDesc: Manage ADB public keys allowed to connect. A deleted host must authorize again.
keys.deleteDesc: The public key for {comment} will be removed. That host must authorize again next time.
settings.notificationDesc: Update an ADB status notification every 15 seconds. Tapping does not navigate; open the WebUI from the manager.
